voScript.text: That blind spot light won't turn off. Every lane change, there it is.
It might not be broken. It might just be blind.
The sensor sits low in the bumper corner — right where mud and slush collect.
A covered sensor reports the same fault as a failed one. It can't tell the difference.
The other cause: a bumper tap that shifted the sensor's aim, even slightly.
A stuck warning light can point to either — wipe it clean first, that's free.
Still stuck on? Stop by and we'll take a look.
